scoreMeaning: Required schema placeholder. No media quality, element satisfaction, or product score was measured. Verdict applies only to the bounded source and fault-injection review.
blindComparison: Not performed. No browser, real recording, raster frame, reference work, or listener comparison was available in this bounded review. Which clip a stranger would prefer and why remain unmeasured.

included: New tools/mobile_audio_capture.mjs and its audio-specific integration additions in tools/test-iphone-webkit.mjs
Read-only checks against actual production Audio API, settings, new-game setup, door transition and world interaction data
Exact helper-body execution with deterministic VM mocks for capability, acquisition, recording, cleanup and combined faults
Installed Playwright error serialization source/Node checks
excluded: Browser/server launch, remote operation and product edits
Other concurrent test runner additions including gas probes
Actual production AudioContext, MediaRecorder, codec support or decodable media acquisition
Non-silence, channel quality, audiovisual synchronization, speaker output, mobile frame rate, touch route completion and reference or blind comparison

addressedCandidates.resolution: All setup begins inside try; created tracks are registered immediately. Stop, disconnect and every track stop are attempted independently, global handle is cleared, and original settings restore in finally. Every tested allocation/start/connect failure now releases already-created tracks.
Scope interpolates report.browser and records it explicitly; normal and Chromium mock cases report no label mismatch.

Setup, recording, per-clip and outer cleanup now preserve essential primary and release-error messages in surfaced text. Each independent cleanup/settings step is attempted. All three combined cases in the original 20-fixture probe retain both messages; a separate six-case installed Playwright serialization probe retains all required messages in final stack-only reporting, including keyboard release and settings restoration faults.

verifiedSourceClaims: Production Audio._create connects masterGain to comp to ctx.destination. Capture adds a comp output to a new MediaStreamAudioDestination and disconnects only that added destination. No replacement AudioContext, synthesized test tones, compressor changes or forced volume values appear in the helper.

ready, unlocked, ctx, ambienceState, musicState, _voiceList and gain fields match production Audio. The caller checks no context before its first user gesture. The helper requests a normal trusted touchscreen tap and observes the existing context.
Only quality is changed to medium with existing settings spread through. Original settings are restored in finally, including when an ordinary independent cleanup step throws in the fault model.

Arcade placement finds the actual door_arcade interaction targeting arcade_in and awaits production Director.enterDoor, which sets currentInterior and mood/ppm and returns gameplay. Programmatic setup is disclosed in the evidence.
Missing recorder, captureStream or supported MIME marks acquisition not measured. The helper does not convert missing capabilities or present/nonzero tracks into an audio-quality verdict.

Normal and Chromium fixtures each traverse three mocked clips, preserve the original audible connection, stop tracks, clear the recording handle, release W, restore settings and record no failing mock checks.
observations: Mock clip bytes are explicit unit fixture bytes held by a write spy; no media files were generated. Passing these source probes cannot prove actual capture works.
Actual scene ambience is recorded rather than forced. Existing interior/zone ambience routing is unchanged and not an issue attributed to these additions.
Readiness is observed immediately after the tap; no supported-run timing failure was established, so a hypothetical first-unlock timing concern is not promoted to a finding.

A cleanup/settings API deliberately made to persistently throw cannot be guaranteed to complete; the helper attempts independent remaining work and exposes the failure. The caller closes the page/context/browser after an aborted run.

checks: Normal and Chromium complete three mocked clips with no failed checks
Unsupported recorder/capture/MIME paths explicitly remain not measured
Every injected fault surfaces, and primary plus cleanup messages remain for all three combined faults
Original audible connection remains, recording handle is removed, settings restore and W is released in all original 20 fixtures
Tracks stop except the single video track whose own stop is deliberately made to persistently throw; independent audio cleanup still runs
Every mocked page.evaluate exception crosses installed Playwright serializeError/parseError
Final stack-only report retains primary plus cleanup/input/settings messages
All tracks end and recording handles clear in these fixtures
Keyboard release failure does not skip recording cleanup or settings restoration attempts
When settings restoration itself is made to throw, its failure surfaces and restoration is marked attempted rather than falsely completed

verification.limitations: These are exact-source control-flow and installed serializer tests with fake browser/audio/media APIs. They do not execute WebKit, capture real audio/video, decode a clip, judge sound quality, compare references or satisfy product elements.
